name: The generation of the Flood
charge: Corruption and violence filling the earth
summary: A whole world under judgment. The earth was filled with violence and every imagination of the heart was continually evil, so God resolved to blot out what he had made, sparing only Noah's household.
offense: Not one offense but a saturation: corruption of all flesh, violence without restraint, wickedness so total that it grieved God that he had made man.
judgment: The Flood. Every living thing on the dry land perished; eight souls were carried through in the ark. The waters were both execution and cleansing.
